correctness.rationale: For each source level, least and greatest target levels give ordered image intervals. Equality between consecutive interval boundaries forces a singleton image in that target antichain; absence of such a singleton forces h strictly separated nonempty intervals into exactly h target levels, hence exact level preservation. Any nonspecial image therefore contains a singleton ordinal-sum factor and contracts explicitly. Pointwise upper and lower comparability to a special map force equality by induction. Counting and the tensor-product homology rank formula then follow. Exhaustive checks on four unequal triples agree with every asserted finite consequence; those checks are corroborative, not the general proof.
